title: 6분 후 도착
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie acoustic pop. A bright acoustic guitar plays a steady eighth-note strumming pattern. A clean electric bass guitar follows the root notes of the progression with a warm, rounded tone. Male vocals are delivered in a conversational, mid-range tenor with a relaxed, rhythmic cadence. The arrangement is intimate and stripped-back, focusing on the interplay between the percussive acoustic guitar strums and the vocal melody. Key of G Major. Tempo is 105 BPM.
